name: @certinia/apex-log-mcp

tools.name: apexlog_list_slow_operations
tools.description: Rank what an Apex debug log spent its time on by self-execution time, or on the heap it retains - code units, methods, queries, searches, DML, callouts, flows and workflows in one table, each row with its calls, durations, database counts and rows, so the caller can see what to optimize and why, beside the query optimizer's plan for the queries among them.

debugCategory.description: Rank only these debug log categories

type.description: Rank only these log event types, e.g. SOQL_EXECUTE_BEGIN, DML_BEGIN, METHOD_ENTRY

minSelfMs.description: Drop operations below this self time (default: 0), whichever sortBy is used

limit.description: Page size (default: 10); fewer if the page would be too large

offset.description: Ranked rows to skip (default: 0): the last page's nextOffset

groupBy.description: Fold repeats into one row; default name. callerNamespace attributes platform DML to the package that drove it. debugCategory folds a namespace's event types together and so states no type or name. none ranks each call on its own. A grouped durationTotalMs is what the transaction takes back if the group never runs - never sum it across rows.

sortBy.description: Default durationSelfMs. heapSelfNetBytes adds that column.

tools.name: apexlog_get_summary
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of an Apex debug log: how long the transaction ran, where the time went by debug log category and the level each was logged at, every governor limit it and each namespace consumed, whether the log is complete, the exceptions and flow errors it raised, and what ended the transaction if it failed. Best for a quick overview.

tools.name: apexlog_list_limit_risks
tools.description: List the governor limits an Apex log transaction has nearly used up - CPU time, heap, SOQL queries and rows, SOSL queries, DML statements and rows, callouts and every other limit - worst first, with how much of each was used

tools.name: apexlog_search_events
tools.description: Search the events of an Apex debug log in log order: what the code printed (USER_DEBUG), validation rules, statements, or every event under one method. For plain text in the saved .log, grep is cheaper; use this for event types, nesting, or without a shell. Text past 400 characters is elided; ask for one event by eventId to read up to 30,000.

type.description: Only these log event types, e.g. USER_DEBUG, VALIDATION_RULE

contains.description: Only events whose text holds this, ignoring case

eventId.description: Only this event, with more of its text

offset.description: Rows to skip (default: 0): the last page's nextOffset

tools.name: apexlog_list_org_logs
tools.description: List the debug logs stored in a Salesforce org, with how many match. Pass ids to apexlog_get_org_logs to download them.

targetOrg.description: Alias or username of the target Salesforce org. Uses the project default if not specified.

operation.description: Part of the operation, any case, e.g. "aura" for /aura

succeeded.description: true: succeeded logs only; false: failed logs only

tools.name: apexlog_get_org_logs
tools.description: Download debug logs from a Salesforce org, by id or the newest N, and return each saved file's path, which the analysis tools accept.

targetOrg.description: Alias or username of the target Salesforce org. Uses the project default if not specified.

latest.description: The newest N logs, in place of ids (default: 1)

outputDir.description: Log directory (default: .apex-log-mcp/ in the first client root, else cwd)

tools.name: apexlog_create_trace_flag
tools.description: Trace a user, class or trigger in a Salesforce org until the trace flag expires. A user's flag stores each transaction they run as a debug log, which can fill log storage; a class or trigger flag only sets that code's levels. Refused if a flag of its log type overlaps the new one. Leaves a debug level in the org.

targetOrg.description: Alias or username of the target Salesforce org. Uses the project default if not specified.

tracedEntity.description: A username or user id, or a class or trigger name (ns.Name if namespaced)

debugLevel.description: A level for every category, or the named ones over apexlog_execute_anonymous's defaults (default: those)

tools.name: apexlog_execute_anonymous
tools.description: Execute anonymous Apex in a Salesforce org as the targetOrg user; DML commits unless the run fails. Saves the debug log and returns its path for the analysis tools. With no active trace flag, adds one for the run, deleted after, and a debug level, left in the org.

apex.description: The anonymous Apex to execute, or use apexFilePath

apexFilePath.description: Absolute path to a file of anonymous Apex

targetOrg.description: Alias or username of the target Salesforce org. Uses the project default if not specified.

outputDir.description: Log directory (default: .apex-log-mcp/ in the first client root, else cwd)

debugLevel.description: This run's log levels. Omit for the user's trace flag levels, else the defaults; "default" forces the defaults; a bare level sets every category; an object sets the named categories over the defaults. Defaults: apexCode, apexProfiling, visualforce, workflow FINE; callout, system, validation DEBUG; database FINEST; nba, wave INFO.

instructions: Analysis tools take an absolute .log path and never contact an org. Every duration is milliseconds, and every governor limit is a count except cpuTime in milliseconds and heapSize in bytes. Start with apexlog_get_summary, then go deeper. A zero count or limit is measured, not missing. Tools that change a production org, or one of unknown type, ask the user first, or refuse if the client cannot ask.
